SignupEmails.verificationBody: We received a registration on SEDES with this address. Please confirm that this email belongs to you to continue.
SignupEmails.decisionApprovedBody: Your registration was approved. The platform is available for access.
SignupEmails.decisionRejectedBody: We reviewed your request to access SEDES and it was not approved this time.
SignupEmails.decisionRejectedFollowUp: If you believe this was a mistake, reply to this email describing how you plan to use the platform.
SignupEmails.passwordResetBody: We received a request to change the password of your SEDES account. Use the button below to choose a new password. The link is valid for one hour and can only be used once.
SignupEmails.passwordResetIgnore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email: your password stays the same.
SignupEmails.existingAccountSubject: You already have a SEDES account
SignupEmails.existingAccountTitle: This email already has an account
SignupEmails.existingAccountBody: We received a SEDES (Strategic System on Desertification and Drought) sign-up with this address, but it already has an account — sometimes created on another OCA platform that shares the same login. There is no need to sign up again: sign in with that account's email and password.
SignupEmails.existingAccountForgot: Don't remember the password? Choose a new one at:
SignupEmails.existingAccountIgnore: If you did not try to sign up, ignore this email: nothing changed in your account.
SignupEmails.fallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
SignupEmails.footer: SEDES — Strategic System on Desertification and Drought
